Psycho-biddy | Psycho-biddy is a colloquial term for a subgenre of the horror/thriller movie that features a formerly-glamorous older woman who has become mentally unbalanced and terrorizes those around her. It has also been referred to by the terms Grande Dame Guignol, hagsploitation and hag horror.  Renata Adler, in her "The New York Times" review for the 1968 film "The Anniversary", referred to the genre as "the Terrifying Older Actress Filicidal Mummy genre."
